legal_norm.definition: Fraction of available actions that are legal.

state_magnitude.definition: Root mean square of normalized state values.

state_dispersion.definition: Standard deviation of normalized state values.

state_boundary_margin.definition: One minus the larger normalized CartPole position/angle magnitude.

state_range.definition: Maximum minus minimum normalized state value.

state_positive_fraction.definition: Fraction of normalized state values greater than zero.

state_negative_fraction.definition: Fraction of normalized state values less than zero.

state_sparsity.definition: Fraction of normalized state values with absolute value at most 1e-6.

state_iqr.definition: 75th minus 25th percentile of normalized state values.

state_skewness.definition: Standardized third central moment; zero for near-constant states.

state_entropy.definition: Normalized Shannon entropy of absolute state-value mass; zero for all-zero states.

state_position_moment.definition: Signed first moment of values over normalized feature index; order-sensitive.

state_position_spread.definition: Absolute-mass-weighted spread over normalized feature index; order-sensitive.

state_adjacent_difference.definition: Mean absolute difference between adjacent normalized state features; order-sensitive.

state_sign_change_fraction.definition: Fraction of adjacent feature pairs with opposite nonzero signs; order-sensitive.

transition_delta_mean.definition: Mean normalized observation change from the previous environment step; zero before the first transition.

transition_delta_abs_mean.definition: Mean absolute normalized observation change from the previous environment step.

transition_delta_max_abs.definition: Maximum absolute normalized observation change from the previous environment step.

transition_state_alignment.definition: Cosine alignment between current normalized observation and its previous-step change; zero when either vector has negligible norm.
